dashboard.greeting: Hi {name}, here is your next interview
dashboard.subtitle: Upload any document, the AI reads it, then you have a relaxed podcast-style conversation about your ideas.
dashboard.previewText: Upload a draft, the AI reads it, then you have a relaxed voice conversation about your ideas.
dashboard.filterEmpty: No assignments in this category right now.

self.title: Start your own task
self.subtitle: Upload any document (a draft, slides, a summary or a position paper) and walk into a short podcast-style interview that surfaces how deeply you really understand it.
self.step1: Upload a document (PDF, DOCX or TXT, up to 25MB).
self.step2: The AI reads it and maps your key ideas.
self.step3: A minute later: a live conversation, not a test.

upload.title: What are we exploring today?
upload.subtitle: Your document stays private. Feel free to upload rough drafts. The AI handles them.
upload.tipBody: For long papers, you can upload just the section you'd like to talk about.

details.lecturerTipBody: Don't memorize answers. The interview rewards real thinking: pauses, course corrections and "wait, let me reconsider" are all good signs.
details.fourSteps: Four steps. Most of it is just a conversation.
details.stepUploadDesc: Submit your draft (PDF, DOCX, or text).
details.stepAnalyzeDesc: The AI reads your work and surfaces the main ideas.
details.stepInterviewDesc: A calm voice conversation, about 12 minutes.
details.stepFinishDesc: That's it. Your submission receipt arrives by email.
details.pauseAnytime: You can pause and come back anytime.

upload.title: Drag your draft here.
upload.subtitle: PDF, DOCX, or TXT, up to 25 MB. The AI host will read it before the interview.
upload.orClick: or click to choose, and we'll handle the rest
upload.draftEnoughBody: No need to polish. The AI reads ideas, not grammar. You can expand and refine your thinking out loud during the interview.
upload.errorTooLarge: This file is too large. Please upload a file up to 25 MB.
upload.errorUnsupported: Please upload a PDF, DOCX, or TXT file.
upload.errorGeneric: Upload failed. Please try again or contact your lecturer.

processing.title: One moment, the host is reading your work.
processing.subtitle: Usually takes about thirty seconds.
processing.errorBody: Please try again or contact your lecturer.

lobby.title: Your interview is ready.
lobby.subtitle: Take a deep breath. The AI host has read your draft and prepared a relaxed conversation around your ideas. About twelve minutes.
lobby.hostBio: Curious, patient, asks one good follow-up.
lobby.stopAnytime: You can pause or stop anytime.
lobby.tip1Body: A room with minimal background noise. No studio required.
lobby.tip2Body: Pauses, "wait, let me reconsider" and side notes: all welcome.
lobby.tip3Body: It's a conversation, not a recital. Trust your draft.
lobby.stuckBody: Say "I'm not sure" and Aria will rephrase or move on. No penalty.
lobby.languageHint: The host will speak, listen and transcribe in this language only. You can change it until the interview starts.
lobby.languageSaveFailed: We couldn't save your choice. Please try again.

micTest.title: Let's make sure Aria can hear you.
micTest.subtitle: Record a short clip and we'll listen together. About ten seconds.
micTest.permBody: Audio stays on your device until you submit the interview. We never record without your consent.
micTest.permDeniedBody: Please enable mic access in your browser settings to continue.
micTest.recording: Recording… say a sentence or two
micTest.tapToRecord: Tap the microphone to record a short clip
micTest.recordingLimit: Up to 10 seconds · tap again to stop
micTest.silentRecording: We did not detect any sound. Check that your microphone is not muted and try again.
micTest.recorderUnsupported: This browser cannot record a test clip. You can still continue to the interview.
micTest.cameraBody: The camera is used for presence only. The video stays on your device and is not sent to anyone.
micTest.cameraDeniedBody: Allow camera access in your browser settings and try again.
micTest.cameraRequired: This interview requires the camera to start.
micTest.cameraOptional: You can continue without a camera. It will be noted in the lecturer's report.
micTest.cameraNoSignalBody: The camera was allowed but no frames arrive. Check that the lens is not covered and no other app is using the camera, or try another camera.
micTest.cameraKeepOn: The camera stays on for the whole interview and is released automatically when it ends.
micTest.cameraPrivacy: The video stays in your browser. The analysis (presence, number of faces, head and eye direction) runs on your device and passes on numbers only. Nothing is recorded and no identity is checked.
micTest.exemptionLink: I cannot turn on a camera
micTest.exemptionBody: This interview requires a camera. You can continue without one by giving a reason; the request is recorded and shown to the lecturer next to the report. It does not affect the score and is not a suspicion.
micTest.exemption_permission_blocked: Permission is blocked and cannot be changed
micTest.exemptionError: We could not record the request. Please try again.
micTest.exemptionDoneBody: You can start the interview. The lecturer will see that it ran without a camera and the reason you gave.

interview.thinkAloud: Pauses are good. Think out loud.
interview.atCapacity: All interview seats are taken right now. Try again in a few minutes. Your place in the assignment is kept.
interview.leaveBody: Your progress may not be saved.
interview.greetingLine: The host is starting the interview. Speak naturally.
interview.skipBannerBody: The skip is recorded in the report and lowers your score. The host will move on to the next question.
interview.replaceBannerBody: You can swap a question once per interview. The host will ask a different question on the same material, with no effect on your score.
interview.farewell: The host is saying goodbye. Wrapping up in a moment.
interview.cameraNoticeBody: You can continue the interview as usual. Reconnect the camera whenever convenient.
interview.reconnectHint: Your progress is saved. Reconnect to continue from the same question.
interview.resumedChip: We're back, continuing where we left off
interview.unavailableTitle: The interview is not available right now
interview.unavailableBody: We could not open this interview. Try again later or contact your lecturer.
interview.unavailableClosed: The lecturer has closed this assignment, so an interview can no longer start.
interview.sync_pending: Monitoring events waiting to be sent
interview.sync_offline: Offline; monitoring events will be sent when the connection returns
interview.returnNoticeTitle: We noticed you left the exam screen
interview.returnNoticeBody: The event was recorded to keep the assessment fair. You can continue the interview as usual.
interview.returnNoticeRepeatTitle: Reminder: please stay on the exam screen
interview.returnNoticeRepeatBody: This is exit number {n}. Every exit is recorded in the lecturer's report. The interview continues as usual.
interview.cameraRequiredBody: This interview requires a camera. The situation was recorded; keep answering and reconnect the camera when you can.

complete.title: Interview complete.
complete.subtitle: Beautiful work. The conversation is saved and on its way to your lecturer. Expect a response within five business days.
complete.scoringHint: We are grading your answers against the document. This takes about a minute.
complete.transcriptEmpty: No transcript was captured for this interview.
complete.scoringStep2: Mapping your answers against your submission…
complete.scoringStep3: Scoring against the four rubric criteria…
complete.scoringSlow: This is taking a little longer than usual. You can stay on this page. The score will appear here as soon as it is ready.
complete.scoringFailed: The score could not be produced automatically. Your lecturer will review the interview and get back to you. You do not need to repeat it.
complete.transcriptMeta: {questions, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} · {messages, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}
complete.transcriptReplaced: You asked for a different question, so it was swapped
complete.transcriptDiscarded: An unclear segment (noise or another language) was left out of the evaluation

history.title: Assignment history
history.subtitle: Every interview you've completed.
history.empty: No completed interviews yet. After your first one, it will show up here.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: Basic details that show up in interviews and reports.

help.title: Help center
help.subtitle: Everything to know before your first interview.
help.q1Body: The AI reads your draft and prepares open-ended, podcast-style questions. You answer aloud. No score, no right/wrong. Just a relaxed chat.
help.q2Body: Make sure you allowed permissions in the browser and that no other app is using the mic. If it persists, return to the mic-test page.
help.q3Title: Which file types can I upload?
help.q3Body: PDF, DOCX, or TXT, up to 25 MB and 30 pages. PPTX, ZIP, and code files coming later.
help.q4Body: The conversation is delivered to your lecturer. You'll receive a submission receipt by email; the grade returns through your course's normal channel.

auth.title: Welcome back
auth.subtitle: Sign in to see your assignments.
auth.magicSent: We sent you a link. Check your email.
auth.errorAnonymousDisabled: Anonymous sign-in is disabled in the project. Enable it in Supabase (Authentication → Providers → Anonymous) or sign in with email.
auth.guestHint: Anonymous session: real uploads and scoring, no email yet
auth.lecturerSubtitle: Sign in to manage courses, open assignments and read interview reports.
auth.lecturerHint: The dashboard is available to accounts with a lecturer role only.

notFound.title: Page not found.
notFound.body: The link you followed does not exist, or the assignment was removed.

consent.title: Almost there!
consent.p1: The interview is your chance to explain your work in your own way. Perfect answers are not the point. What we care about is your thinking and your understanding.
consent.p2Camera: To keep the experience fair for everyone, a few checks run during the interview, such as the camera and noticing when the window changes. We recommend staying on the interview screen and answering on your own, without help from AI tools or other people.
consent.p2Activity: To keep the experience fair for everyone, a few checks run during the interview, such as noticing when the window changes. We recommend staying on the interview screen and answering on your own, without help from AI tools or other people.
consent.p2Minimal: To keep the experience fair for everyone, your answers are saved and compared with the work you submitted. We recommend answering on your own, without help from AI tools or other people.
consent.p3: You can take a moment to think, ask for clarification, and it is fine not to know an answer. Aria is here to have a pleasant conversation with you.
consent.error: We could not save your acknowledgement. Please try again.
consent.disclosureTitle: What is collected, who sees it, how long it is kept
consent.collectedAudio: Your voice is sent to OpenAI for the conversation and transcribed. The transcript is kept.
consent.collectedTiming: Response times and answer lengths, as measured in the browser.
consent.collectedActivity: Switches to other windows or tabs and connection drops, with time and duration.
consent.collectedCamera: The camera is used for presence only: the faces in the frame, head direction and eye direction are worked out on your device. No video is recorded or sent.
consent.collectedDocument: Your answers are compared with the text of the work you submitted.
consent.accessBody: The course lecturer sees the report, the transcript and the recorded events. You see your own report and transcript.
consent.retentionBody: Data is kept for the course and the review process, according to your institution's policy. Access, correction or deletion requests go through the lecturer or support.
consent.noAutoVerdict: Nothing is failed automatically. Every finding is reviewed by a person, and you have the right to see it, respond and appeal.
consent.legalNote: This acknowledgement is notice and consent for the interview. It does not replace your institution's policy or applicable law.
consent.monitorBodyBoth: To keep the exam fair, leaving the exam screen and presence in front of the camera are monitored during the interview. Unusual events may appear in the lecturer's report. Looking off-screen for a long time or again and again puts a warning sign on your camera view. Please stay on the exam screen for the whole interview.
consent.monitorBodyTabs: To keep the exam fair, leaving the exam screen is monitored during the interview. Unusual events may appear in the lecturer's report. Please stay on the exam screen for the whole interview.
consent.monitorBodyCamera: To keep the exam fair, presence in front of the camera is monitored during the interview. Unusual events may appear in the lecturer's report. Looking off-screen for a long time or again and again puts a warning sign on your camera view. Please stay in front of the camera for the whole interview.
consent.cannotTabs: A second device, a split screen or a window open beside the interview. Only what this browser reports is recorded.
consent.cannotCamera: A virtual camera, a fake video or anything outside the frame. Head and eye direction are rough estimates, not precise eye tracking.
consent.cannotProof: No event is proof of cheating. The lecturer sees events for a human check only.
consent.storedTabs: When you left the screen, when you came back, for how long, and which question was active.
consent.storedCamera: The number of faces in the frame, the head direction and the warnings shown on your camera view, as numbers only, and only when they stay unusual for a while.
consent.storedNoVideo: No video, images or biometric data are stored. The analysis runs on your device.

lecturer.noAccessTitle: No access to the lecturer dashboard
lecturer.noAccessBody: This account is registered as a student. The lecturer role is granted by your institution's administrator, not through the app.
lecturer.dashboardSubtitle: Open a course, add students by e-mail, open an assignment. Students upload their work on their side and are interviewed; the reports arrive here.
lecturer.emptyBody: Open a first course, add students by e-mail, then open an assignment. Students will see it on their dashboard.
lecturer.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
lecturer.addStudentsHint: E-mails separated by commas or new lines. Students need to sign up to Podtask with the same e-mail to be added.
lecturer.noStudents: No students in this course yet. Add them by e-mail.
lecturer.noAssignments: No assignments in this course yet.
lecturer.integrityTitle: Integrity measures (each can be turned off)
lecturer.silenceNudge: Seconds of silence before a gentle nudge (0 disables)
lecturer.noReport: The report is not ready yet. It is generated a few minutes after the interview ends.
lecturer.noAnswer: No answer was captured for this question.
lecturer.evaluationNone: No understanding evaluation for this question.
lecturer.pauseBefore: A {seconds} second pause before the answer. On its own this does not indicate the use of any aid.
lecturer.signalsIntro: Evidence for a human review, not conclusions. Telemetry (windows, camera, timing) comes from the student's browser and can be bypassed, so it is not absolute proof. Nothing here fails anyone automatically.
lecturer.noSignals: No unusual signals were recorded in this interview.
lecturer.cameraWasOff: The camera was not part of this interview
lecturer.flagHost: Noted by Aria during the conversation
lecturer.eventsNote: Client telemetry. A single switch away from the interview window is not a finding; what matters is a repeated pattern or a combination with an answer that deserves a look.
lecturer.roomNote: (a note from the room to the host)
lecturer.followUp: Request a follow-up conversation with the student
lecturer.note: Internal note (not shown to the student)
lecturer.cat_verbatim_document: Sequence matching a passage of the submission
lecturer.catBody_verbatim_document: A long run of words matches the submitted text. Quoting your own work is legitimate; check the explanation given in the follow-up question.
lecturer.cat_long_pause_then_fluent: Long pauses before long, continuous answers
lecturer.catBody_long_pause_then_fluent: Several questions show a long pause followed by a long, continuous answer. Thinking time, a slow connection or a second language produce the same pattern.
lecturer.catBody_uniform_instant_answers: Every answer started almost immediately, with almost no variation. Fast, confident speakers look like this too.
lecturer.catBody_no_live_session: Answers were stored although no voice session was opened for this interview. This is a server-side fact, not telemetry.
lecturer.catBody_messages_before_start: Some answers were stored before the interview started, according to server timestamps.
lecturer.catBody_implausibly_short: The whole interview took less than a minute and a half by the server clock.
lecturer.catBody_contradiction: Aria heard an answer that contradicts the submission or an earlier answer.
lecturer.catBody_generic_answer: The answer did not engage with the question even after a clarifying question.
lecturer.catBody_cannot_explain_term: The student had difficulty explaining a term the submission itself uses.
lecturer.catBody_cannot_explain_decision: Persistent difficulty explaining a central decision of the work, even after a clarifying question.
lecturer.catBody_technical_context: An unusual technical situation made the answer hard to judge.
lecturer.catBody_other: Aria noted this answer for review.
lecturer.ev_visibility_hidden: Switched away from the interview window
lecturer.ev_multiple_faces: More than one person in the frame
lecturer.ev_own_words_prompt: Asked to explain in their own words
lecturer.limit_host: Noted by Aria during the conversation. It is the host's impression of one answer, relayed through the student's browser, not a verified finding.
lecturer.limit_overlap_raw: Compared with the text of the submitted file. Quoting your own definitions or terms is normal; what matters is whether the idea was then explained in the student's own words (see the follow-up in the transcript).
lecturer.limit_overlap_pdf: Compared with a model-generated rendering of the PDF, not its exact text, so matches are approximate. Quoting your own work is normal; what matters is the explanation that followed.
lecturer.limit_timing: Timing measured in the browser. Thinking time, a slow connection, a noisy room, accessibility needs or answering in a second language produce the same pattern. Read together with the answers themselves.
lecturer.limit_session: Server-side fact: the voice session is created by the server on every room start, and the timestamps are recorded by the server.
lecturer.ev_head_away: Head turned away for a while
lecturer.ev_integrity_warning: Warning shown on the camera view
lecturer.examIntro: Events from the student's browser and camera, for a human check. Nothing here is proof: leaving the screen can be a notification, a missing face can be poor lighting. The data comes from the browser and can be disabled or forged.
lecturer.examScoreSeparate: The knowledge score is computed separately and is not affected by these events.
lecturer.examCameraOff: Camera: not part of this interview
lecturer.examCameraStartedOk: The camera ran during the interview
lecturer.examCameraDenied: Camera permission was denied in the browser
lecturer.examMultiFace: More than one person in frame
lecturer.examOpenLegend: striped: an event that never closed (the page was closed mid-way)
lecturer.examNoEvents: No monitoring events were recorded in this interview.
lecturer.examHumanCheck: Check events marked "needs a check" against the answer to the same question in the transcript, and talk to the student before drawing any conclusion.
lecturer.examLimits: Limits: another device, a split screen or a window beside the room are invisible. Head direction is a rough estimate, not eye tracking. A virtual camera or a recorded video cannot be detected with certainty.
